title: Test-only same-clock two-writer handoff causal-retention regression
instructions: SUPERVISOR QUALITY EVIDENCE ONLY. Create ONLY part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_single_handoff_stale.py. Do not edit runner.py, storage.py, any other production file, existing tests, automation/**, .github/**, main, private, secrets, API/prediction/orchestration, execution/broker/Telegram/MT5, or Railway. Purpose: execute a deterministic no-network two-INDEPENDENT-PROCESS regression against the exact pinned public HEAD, to establish whether same-as_of_ms T concurrent run_once publications can overwrite a newer archived/scoring handoff with an older 0-row snapshot. Use multiprocessing get_context('spawn'), top-level spawn-safe child targets, shared tmp_path local_dir, bounded synchronization events/queues/joins, assert child exitcodes and clean up in finally; never rely on sleep as the synchronization oracle. Child A calls runner.run_once(network=False, as_of_ms=T) on initially empty archive and must demonstrably report archive_records_loaded=0 and scoring_records_loaded=0; intercept ONLY its runner.atomic_write_json call for exact local_dir/anata_latest.json in that child to pause BEFORE publication, and signal parent. While A is paused, child B appends exactly one real scoring FlowObservation with source_record_id='rowB' (family='etf', metric='net_flow_usd', asset='BTC', valid effective/available/observed PIT times <= T) using storage.append_observations, then calls runner.run_once(network=False, as_of_ms=T) and completes. Assert B reports archive_records_loaded=1 and scoring_records_loaded=1; assert B handoff contains causal provenance of rowB via nested source_evidence[*].clock_provenance.effective.source_record_id (inspect actual handoff schema; do not fabricate). Verify persisted anata_latest.json contains rowB while A is paused; release A; after A exits assert persisted anata_latest.json STILL retains rowB, never regresses to 0-row older handoff. Include reverse-order sequential control at fixed T showing B persists without overlapping stale A. Assertions must be non-vacuous and prove both children read different snapshots. Test must be independent of internet, credentials, timing flakiness, and any mock that fakes B provenance. Run targeted pytest then full Capital Flow pytest as supplied. IMPORTANT: if the test reproduces RED on this exact HEAD, DO NOT weaken or skip the causal-retention assertion and DO NOT patch production to make it green; let the bounded executor report FAILED with real pytest trace and do not commit. If it passes honestly, commit only this new test after targeted and full PASS. A NO_CHANGE result is not acceptable unless this exact regression already exists on HEAD. Planner C will independently audit any evidence before promotion.
